Use case: illustration-story. One standalone text-free Georgian-Persian manuscript painting.
Medieval Georgian-Persian illuminated manuscript miniature painting for Shota Rustaveli's "The Knight in the Panther's Skin" (ვეფხისტყაოსანი). 16th–17th-century Georgian royal manuscript miniature, Mamuka Tavakarashvili / King Vakhtang VI illumination tradition blended with classical Persian-Safavid tempera miniature. Egg tempera, lapis lazuli, malachite green, vermilion, warm ochre and burnished antique gold leaf on aged ivory-parchment vellum. Stylized faceted rocky cliffs, ornamental cypress and pomegranate trees, intricately patterned arches and domes, expressive courtly figures in medieval Georgian-Eastern attire. Fine controlled contours, delicately patterned fabrics, luminous matte mineral pigments, slightly flattened layered miniature space with expressive narrative gestures. A painted manuscript scene, not photorealism, cinematic rendering, modern digital fantasy or a collage of circular portraits. Reuse referenced character faces and coloring but adapt costume to the actual chronological story scene; Tariel wears ordinary Indian court or military attire in early backstory, his panther skin belongs to his later exile. Exact horizontal 16:10 composition, preferably native 1600x1000 pixels, a single coherent scene framed for a card vignette. Soft natural painted vignette dissolving to warm aged ivory vellum at edges, modest antique-gold floral flourishes at the perimeter, no rigid border. Key faces and gestures comfortably inside the central safe area, no important content cut off. STRICTLY NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO CAPTIONS, NO NUMBERS, NO INSCRIPTIONS, NO CALLIGRAPHY, NO BANNERS, NO SCROLLS, NO SIGNATURES, NO WATERMARKS anywhere. Architectural ornament must be purely floral/geometric with no pseudo-writing. If letters are narratively necessary, use a small closed plain unmarked folded paper or sealed envelope, never visible writing or rolled scrolls. All book covers/pages must be plain and unmarked. Do not show graphic blood or gore; imply violent events through gestures, context and intact clothing.
Episode 21 — The Three Counsels, Storming of Kadjeti & Liberation of Nestan.
Setting: Kadjeti, the dry rocky INNER COURTYARD of the conquered remote INLAND fortress at early dawn. Angular lilac and ochre cliffs and thick stone fortifications with three recessed landward gate arches recede behind the figures. There is NO sea, coast or ship anywhere.
Scene: immediately after liberation, Tariel and the freed Nestan meet and embrace on a broad low fortress stair. Tariel bends tenderly toward her, his hands resting respectfully on her shoulders; Nestan reaches to his chest in relieved recognition. Avtandil and Pridon stand nearby on opposite sides, their swords lowered in peace after the successful rescue. Exactly four central figures. Small scattered intact shields suggest the ended fight but no dead bodies, no visible wounds or blood. Cypress and sparse pomegranate foliage grow among faceted rocks. Gold sunrise and lapis shadows express release and hope in the miniature tradition. A single coherent aftermath scene, not separate assault panels.
Character identity references: image2 Tariel, curly dark hair, brown-olive skin, short beard, strong features, panther-skin mantle over gold-and-bronze campaign attire (no giant animal head); image3 Nestan, olive-skinned dark-eyed young woman with wavy dark hair, emerald gown with gold floral embroidery, dark veil and emerald diadem; image4 Avtandil, young clean-shaven wavy-haired olive face, silver conical helmet, red cloak and lamellar armor; image5 Pridon, short black hair, close beard and mustache, dark blue tunic with gold trim and rust-red cloak. Use exact face identities, render them as expressive miniature figures. Image1 is style reference only; never draw the poet or medallion circles.
No lettering, no inscriptions, no numbers, no flags, no banners, no scrolls. Exact horizontal16:10 with the same soft natural ivory-parchment vignette as the anchor.

visual_qa.notes: Four recognizable figures in liberated inland fortress, tender reunion, three gate arches, no water/ships, no text/banners/scrolls/gore; consistent vignette.
